method: First reserve the lowest SHA256(seed:bin) record for every observed dimension level and joint stratum. Fill remaining slots by maximizing sqrt(population stratum size)/(selected stratum size+0.5), choosing the next hash-ranked unselected bin in that stratum. Break ties by sorted stratum key.
rules: Use only original metadata and old hydrogenase labels, never new predictions, for selection.
Derive domain and phylum from ranked GTDB classification; the unranked lineage column mixes ranks and must not define domain strata.
Completeness and N50 are metadata strata, not independently verified assembly quality or full contig-length distributions.
Old target_total_count includes other metabolic markers; only explicitly bracketed hydrogenase labels define potential-type strata.
Keep original source quality category and contamination as separate metadata. Completeness bands are not MIMAG quality designations.
The resolved_file column refers to historical annotation TSVs, not FNA or FAA+GFF. Do not infer nonexistent sequence paths.
This diversity-enriched pilot is not a self-weighting random sample; unweighted pilot frequencies must not estimate population prevalence.
Freeze selected bins and source hashes before their new predictions. Missing sequence inputs do not trigger substitution with easier samples.
A sample manifest does not satisfy M4_MAG_PILOT; actual sequence/ownership checks, annotation, old/new review and resource records are required.
